dos.text: Make sure init() has already run before inserting tabs directly, appendChild/insertBefore assume the arrowscrollbox already has its trailing periphery element as its last child, and inserting before init() throws "Shouldn't call this without arrowscrollbox."

donts.text: Don't expect removing this element from the DOM to release its listeners, there's no disconnectedCallback, only a manually-invoked destroy() that removes the pref observer and CustomizableUI listener.

Don't mutate tab or tab-group DOM directly and expect allTabs, openTabs, visibleTabs, or ariaFocusableItems to reflect it immediately, these are memoized fields only invalidated by specific custom events like TabGroupCreate, TabGroupRemoved, SplitViewCreated, and SplitViewRemoved.

behavior.text: Several events tabstrip reacts to aren't dispatched by tabs.mjs itself: TabGroupCreate/TabGroupRemoved come from tabbrowser.js, SplitViewCreated/SplitViewRemoved come from tabbrowser.js too, and TabGroupExpand/TabGroupCollapse come from tab-group; tabstrip only listens, so rebuilding it standalone means also replicating those other dispatchers, not just this one file.
